title: Jolly Snappy Russian Lemongrass Bake
description: A satvik-friendly Russian dish featuring lemongrass, this bake is a herbal and snappy twist on traditional Russian cuisine, evoking nostalgic feelings with its unique flavors.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Chop the lemongrass into 1-inch pieces and saute in oil until fragrant.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start browning.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the vegetable broth, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add the tofu to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the tofu mixture to the sauteed lemongrass mixture and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 30 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh lemongrass.
